title: Cortepi qatipakuy
intro: Poderpa corredorninkunapiqa, huk hatun estatusniyuq runam huk sirvientewan kuyanakurqa, sumaq kayninqa huk pachamantam karqa. Chay munapayasqankun askha sucesokunaman aparqan, chaykunan pruebaman churanman hunt’aq sonqo kayta, pakasqa cheqaq kaqkunata rikuchinman, qhepamantaq chay kamachiq mana huchayoq kayninta sut’inchanman.
clues: Nilo mayu hallp’apin tiyarani, ancha atiyniyoq palaciopin.
Huk wayna wasiyman haykumurqan, paypa qayllanpitaq kay pachayta mana thasnuyta atirqanchu.
Ñoqaqa engañayta munarqanin, ichaqa Señorninmanmi pakakuran.
Qhepanmanta pachan p’achanta llik’irqani, ichaqa pruebakunan rikuchiwarqan q’otusqayta.
Noble warmikunaq ch’aqwayninta upallachinaypaqmi huk huñunakuyman mink’arqani, hinaspan makinkupi filoyoq kaqkunata churarqani.
Tukuyninpiqa, lliwpa qayllanpi huchayta willakurqani, reypa ñawpaqenpi cheqaq kaqta reqsikuspa.

arabic: قَالَ مَا خَطْبُكُنَّ إِذْ رَٰوَدتُّنَّ يُوسُفَ عَن نَّفْسِهِۦ ۚ قُلْنَ حَـٰشَ لِلَّهِ مَا عَلِمْنَا عَلَيْهِ مِن سُوٓءٍۢ ۚ قَالَتِ ٱمْرَأَتُ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْـَٔـٰنَ حَصْحَصَ ٱلْحَقُّ أَنَا۠ رَٰوَدتُّهُۥ عَن نَّفْسِهِۦ وَإِنَّهُۥ لَمِنَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ
verse: Said [the king to the women], "What was your condition when you sought to seduce Joseph?" They said, "Perfect is Allāh! We know about him no evil." The wife of al-ʿAzeez said, "Now the truth has become evident. It was I who sought to seduce him, and indeed, he is of the truthful. (12:51)
